description: Deterministic six-conversation Operator Week history for Threadkeeper demo and QA.

messages.content: Marlowe Freight is seeing duplicate line items on invoices for split shipments — customers are being overcharged. I need to trace the split-shipment billing path and confirm which invoices are affected before anything else. The smallest useful fix is finding the root cause, patching the billing path, and verifying one corrected invoice.

Captured the Marlowe billing bug: split-shipment invoices show duplicate line items. Next steps are tracing the billing path, patching it, and verifying a corrected invoice. The standing Marlowe review call remains Wednesday at 2:00 PM.

The invoice follow-up format worked well: check three signals — days overdue, any open support issue, and payment history — explain why each matters, then give one recommended follow-up action. I want a reusable invoice follow-up workflow instead of ad hoc reminder emails.
The reusable structure is three signals — days overdue, open support issues, and payment history — why they matter, and one recommended follow-up action.

The split-shipment bug traces back further than expected — there is a related proration bug when a shipment splits mid-billing-cycle. The billing fix scope has grown beyond the original patch. I am blocked tracing the proration logic, but I am not abandoning the fix.
Recorded a scope-expansion event and an unresolved blocker on the proration logic. The evidence does not establish the billing fix being abandoned.

The billing fix is close to ready — I shipped the fix to staging. But I need to move the standing Marlowe review call: it was Wednesday at 2:00 PM, but that conflicts with another commitment. Moving it to Thursday at 10:00 AM instead. Keep Wednesday 2:00 PM as historical context, but the current call time is Thursday 10:00 AM.
Staging deploy noted. The Wednesday 2:00 PM call time is superseded by Thursday 10:00 AM for the standing Marlowe billing review.

I want a repeatable way to check in on overdue invoices instead of guessing. Marlowe's retainer invoice is overdue, and their AP contact mentioned they are waiting on the billing fix. The invoice follow-up structure of three signals, why they matter, and one action could apply here.
This may connect the invoice follow-up workflow to the Marlowe billing fix as a possible reason for the overdue invoice. Treat that as a proposal, not a fact.

I am restarting verification on the Marlowe billing fix. It is deployed to production, and I have drafted the customer-facing fix summary for Marlowe. I still need to confirm the next invoice run has no duplicate line items. I want that verified by August 20, 2026, before the standing Thursday call with Marlowe.

Marlowe billing fix is active again after the scope delay. The fix is deployed to production and the customer-facing summary is drafted. The invoice-verification loop remains open with a due date of August 20, 2026.
